Everyone knows I have the biggest sweet tooth and the @Kalo app helps me enjoy what I love & track my goals - I’m loving it! 🥰  Cake  300 g (2 ⅛ cups) Gf flour w/ xanthan gum 35 g (¼ cup + 1 tbsp) cornstarch 11 g (2 ¼ tsp) baking powder 2 g (½ tsp) baking soda 3 g (½ tsp) fine sea salt 330 g (1 ⅔ cups) sugar 300 g (1 ¼ cups) milk of choice, room temperature 15 g (1 tbsp) apple cider vinegar 155 g (⅔ cup) neutral oil 200 g (¾ cup + 2 tbsp) yogurt of choice 12 g (1 tbsp) vanilla bean paste Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 325°F. Line three 8-inch round pans with parchment. 2. Whisk dry ingredients together. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk wet ingredients together. 4. Add dry ingredients to wet. Whisk until smooth. 5. Let batter sit for 5 minutes, then whisk again for 10 seconds. 6. Divide evenly between pans. 7. Bake at 325°F for 25 minutes, until centers are set. 8. Cool 10-15 minutes in pans, then remove/cool completely. Filling Ingredients 120 g butter of choice (3 sticks) 60 g heavy cream of choice (~1/4 cup) 120 g powdered sugar (1 cup) 20 g light corn syrup (1 tbsp) 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ⅛ tsp fine sea salt Instructions 1. Heat butter and heavy cream together until fully melted and smooth. 2. Whisk in powdered sugar until completely smooth and glossy. 3. Add syrup, vanilla, and salt.  4. Let sit until cool & slightly thickened. Buttercream Ingredients 340 g (3 sticks) butter of choice 520 g (4 cups) powdered sugar 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ¼ tsp fine sea salt 40 g (3 tbsp) heavy cream of choice Instructions 1. Beat butter for 3-5 minutes until light and fluffy. 2. Add powdered sugar and mix for 5-7 minutes. 3. Add vanilla bean paste and salt. 4. Slowly stream in heavy cream and mix on low Assembly 1. Level cake layers if needed. 2. Pipe a buttercream dam around the edge of each layer. 3. Fill the center with lava filling. 4. Stack and repeat with remaining layers.

🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. The epitome of chocolate heaven🍫🤩🍰 if you love chocolate, you need this crockpot chocolate lava cake in your life!🙌 Crockpot Chocolate Lava Cake Recipe: Ingredients:  Cake Batter: 1 cup all-purpose flour ¾ cup granulated sugar 3 tbsps cocoa powder 2 tsps baking powder  ¼ tsp salt ½ cup milk ⅓ cup butter ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 tsps vanilla bean paste Cake Topping: ¾ cup granulated sugar ¾ cup light brown sugar ⅓ cup cocoa powder ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 ¼ cup hot water Instructions: 1. Mix cake batter dry ingredients: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, granulated sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.  2. Mix cake batter wet ingredients: In a separate bowl, microwave your butter and dark chocolate chips in 30 second increments until fully melted.  3. Combine your wet & dry ingredients, & spread it on the bottom of your crockpot. 4. Cake Topping: Mix your granulated sugar, brown sugar, & cocoa powder together. Sprinkle this on top of your cake batter along with the chocolate chips. Pour your hot water overtop of everything, & don’t stir it in. 5. Cover, & cook on high for 2-2.5 hours. Cokelat pekat dan mint segar berpadu dalam mousse gunung meletus yang mewah tanpa oven. Bahan simpel, hasil elegan—cocok buat ide frozen dessert atau camilan cantik di rumah. Simak resepnya dan tag sahabatmu yang wajib cobain juga! 🍫 --- Volcano Mint Choco Mousse Cake ❄️🌋 (Kue Mousse Cokelat Mint Gunung Meletus Beku) 🍰 Bahan A – Mousse Cokelat Mint Cream cheese: 250 gram Gula pasir halus: 30 gram Whipping cream cair (bisa pakai merek Anchor/Elle & Vire): 150 ml Gelatin bubuk: 10 gram (rendam dulu dengan 3 sdm air dingin, biarkan mengembang) Susu UHT hangat: 80 ml Cokelat chip atau dark compound chocolate cincang: 40 gram Sirup mint (bisa pakai sirup daun mint botolan atau pasta mint): 50 ml 🍫 Bahan B – Dekorasi Whipping cream cair: 30 ml Dark chocolate: 20 gram Ceri segar atau kalengan: 4 buah --- 👩‍🍳 Langkah Pembuatan: 1. Campurkan cream cheese dan gula pasir dalam mangkuk, aduk menggunakan whisk atau mixer kecepatan rendah hingga lembut dan halus. Tambahkan whipping cream, aduk hingga tercampur rata. 2. Panaskan susu hangat, lalu masukkan gelatin yang sudah direndam, aduk hingga larut sempurna. Tambahkan cokelat dan sirup mint, aduk rata hingga cokelat mencair. 3. Tuang campuran gelatin ke adonan cream cheese, aduk rata perlahan hingga semua tercampur halus. Tuang ke dalam cetakan silikon berbentuk bulat atau setengah bola. Simpan dalam freezer selama 6 jam atau hingga benar-benar beku. 4. Ganache: Lelehkan dark chocolate dan whipping cream secara terpisah di microwave selama 30 detik, lalu campurkan keduanya dan aduk hingga mengkilap. 5. Keluarkan mousse dari cetakan, tuang ganache hangat di atasnya untuk efek meleleh seperti gunung berapi, lalu hias dengan ceri di atasnya. Sajikan beku untuk sensasi segar-lumer di mulut! #ResepKue #Dessert #Mousse #MousseTanpaOven #FrozenDessert #KueMint #KueEnak #KueAntiGagal #IdeCemilan

Oreo Chocolate Volcano Cake. 
 Ingredients 
 Chocolate Sponge Cake
 ● 45g corn oil, about 3 tbsp
 ● 65g whole milk, about 1/4 cup
 ● 55g cake flour, about 1/2 cup
 ● 15g unsweetened cocoa powder, about 2 tbsp
 ● 5 large eggs, separated
 ● 50g granulated sugar, about 1/4 cup
 ● A few drops fresh lemon juice 
 Whipped Cream
 ● 400g heavy whipping cream, about 1 2/3 cups
 ● 30g granulated sugar, about 2 1/2 tbsp 
 Chocolate Ganache
 ● 70g heavy whipping cream, about 1/4 cup + 2 tsp
 ● 50g chocolate, finely chopped 
 Oreo Layer & Topping
 ● Oreo cookies, crushed, as needed 
 Making Process 
 1. Make the Chocolate Ganache
 ● Warm the 70g heavy cream and pour it over the chocolate. Stir until completely melted and
 glossy. Set aside to cool slightly. 
 2. Make the Chocolate Batter
 ● Whisk the corn oil and milk until emulsified. Sift in the cake flour and cocoa powder, then
 mix in the egg yolks until smooth. 
 3. Whip the Meringue
 ● Add a few drops of lemon juice to the egg whites. Gradually add the sugar and whip until
 the meringue holds soft-to-medium peaks. Gently fold it into the chocolate batter. 
 4. Bake the Sponge  ● Spread the batter evenly in a lined sheet pan. Bake at 300°F / 150°C for 30 minutes. Cool completely, then cut the sponge into the cake pieces needed for layering. 
 5. Whip the Cream
 ● Beat the heavy whipping cream with the sugar until thick, smooth, and firm enough for filling and frosting. 
 6. Build the Oreo Layers
 ● Layer the chocolate sponge with whipped cream and crushed Oreos, keeping an opening
 in the center to create the volcano effect shown in the video. 
 7. Frost & Chill
 ● Cover the assembled cake with whipped cream and smooth the outside. Chill until firm enough to hold its shape. 
 8. Create the Chocolate Volcano
 ● Fill the center generously with chocolate ganache so it flows over the top and down the
 sides. Finish with plenty of crushed Oreo pieces for the crunchy final layer.
